name: Julen De La Serna
title: Julen De La Serna · Filmmaker and cinematographer in the Basque Country
description: Portfolio of Julen De La Serna: music videos, documentaries and audiovisual pieces shot and produced from Vitoria-Gasteiz, Basque Country.

about.lead: My passion is creating audiovisual content that conveys experiences. Stories to be told.
body: For me, every new project is a chance to create something different. This site reflects my passion and my experience: the personal projects I have been able to carry out in recent years, thanks to which I have grown and added my grain of sand to an audiovisual world that never stops changing.
about.photoAlt: Julen De La Serna holding a cinema camera

services.title: Ready
services.text: It all starts with a good story. Storytelling backed by broad experience in creating audiovisual experiences.

services.title: Set
services.text: Motion graphics, 2D-3D animation and compositing. Workflows in After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro and Cinema 4D.

services.title: Action
services.text: Own shooting gear and know-how from the latest brands in the audiovisual world: RED, Blackmagic, Sony, Freefly, DJI.
